name: DAAD EPOS (Development-Related Postgraduate Courses)
benefits: 100% Tuition fee exemption at partner universities
Monthly living stipend of €934 for Master / €1,300 for PhD
Round-trip international flight airfare
Comprehensive German health, accident, and liability insurance
2 to 6 months preparatory German language course in Germany
bdSpecificNotes: Requires at least 2 years of relevant professional work experience after Bachelor graduation. Apply directly to the selected German university offering the EPOS course.

name: Helmut-Schmidt-Programme (DAAD PPGG)
benefits: Full tuition waiver for Master programs in Public Policy and Governance
Monthly scholarship rate of €934
Travel allowance for flights to and from Germany
Health insurance and study/research subsidies
Free 6-month preparatory German language course
bdSpecificNotes: Designed for future leaders in politics, law, economics, and public administration. Candidates apply to up to two participating German universities simultaneously.

name: Deutschlandstipendium (National Scholarship Programme)
benefits: €300 per month non-repayable cash stipend for at least 2 semesters
Can be received regardless of personal or parental income
Networking with corporate sponsors and alumni mentors
bdSpecificNotes: Available to enrolled international students at virtually all German universities based on outstanding academic results and social commitment.

name: Chevening Scholarships
benefits: Full university tuition fees for any 1-year Master degree in the UK
Monthly living allowance / stipend
Economy class return airfare to the UK from Dhaka
Arrival and excess baggage allowances
Access to exclusive networking events and British diplomatic receptions

deadline.note: Early October; exact date on the Bangladesh country page

bdSpecificNotes: Mandatory minimum 2 years (2,800 hours) of work experience. Applicants must demonstrate strong leadership potential and commit to returning to Bangladesh for at least 2 years.

name: Commonwealth Master's Scholarships
benefits: Approved airfare from Bangladesh to the UK and return
Full tuition and examination fees
Stipend of £1,347 per month (or £1,652 per month for London universities)
Warm clothing allowance and study travel grants
bdSpecificNotes: Nominations are handled through the University Grants Commission (UGC) Bangladesh / Ministry of Education. Watch for the UGC official circular in September.

name: GREAT Scholarships
benefits: Direct £10,000 tuition fee discount applied to 1-year postgraduate taught courses
Exclusive invitation to a welcome event hosted by the British Council in the UK
bdSpecificNotes: Open to passport holders from Bangladesh. Must hold an offer of admission from a participating UK university before applying.

name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
provider: U.S. Department of State / US Embassy Dhaka
benefits: Full tuition and all university academic fees
Monthly living stipend tailored to the US university city
Round-trip international air travel
Health benefit plan (ASPE)
Pre-academic English training and professional enrichment seminars

deadline.note: 11 July 2026 for the 2027-28 cycle; changes every year

bdSpecificNotes: Administered directly by the Public Affairs Section of the U.S. Embassy in Dhaka. Strong preference for junior faculty, public servants, and civil society leaders.

name: US Graduate Teaching & Research Assistantship (TA/RA)
benefits: 100% Tuition waiver for 9 to 12 credit hours per semester
Monthly salary/stipend (,800 to ,800/mo depending on department)
Subsidized university student health insurance
In-state tuition rate qualification for additional courses
bdSpecificNotes: The primary way Bangladeshi STEM students fund their Master and PhD in America. Awarded directly by university academic departments in exchange for 20 hrs/week teaching or lab research.

name: MEXT Scholarship (Japanese Government - Embassy Track)
provider: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT)
benefits: 100% University admission and tuition fees waived
Monthly allowance: ¥143,000 (Master) to ¥145,000 (PhD)
Round-trip international flight tickets between Dhaka and Tokyo
6 months intensive Japanese language training in Japan
bdSpecificNotes: Application is announced annually by the Ministry of Education Bangladesh. Involves written screening exams (English/Japanese/Math) at the Embassy of Japan in Dhaka.

name: Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship
benefits: 100% Exemption from tuition fees for the entire duration of study
Free dormitory placement or housing contribution of HUF 40,000/month
Monthly stipend: HUF 43,700 (Bachelor/Master) / HUF 140,000-180,000 (PhD)
Comprehensive national health insurance coverage in Hungary
bdSpecificNotes: Bilateral agreement with 140 reserved seats for Bangladesh. Students must apply on the DreamApply portal AND submit documents to the Ministry of Education Bangladesh / UGC.

name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degrees (EMJMD)
benefits: Full participation costs (tuition, laboratory, library access) covered
Monthly living allowance of €1,400 per month for 24 months
€2,000 - €3,000 annual travel and installation grant
Worldwide health and accident insurance
Joint or multiple Master degrees from at least two European universities
bdSpecificNotes: Bangladesh consistently ranks in the top 3 recipient countries worldwide for Erasmus Mundus scholarships. Students study across 2 to 3 different European countries during their 2-year degree.

name: Türkiye Bursları (Turkey Government Scholarships)
provider: Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities (YTB)
benefits: 100% University tuition fee waiver
Free university dormitory accommodation
Monthly stipend: 3,500 TL (Bachelor), 5,000 TL (Master), 6,500 TL (PhD)
One-time return flight ticket between Dhaka and Turkey
1-year free Turkish language course
bdSpecificNotes: Application is completely free and submitted online directly through the Türkiye Bursları portal. Shortlisted candidates are interviewed in-person in Dhaka.

name: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC)
benefits: Full tuition fee waiver
Free campus dormitory accommodation or subsidized housing
Monthly living stipend: RMB 2,500 (Bachelor), RMB 3,000 (Master), RMB 3,500 (PhD)
Comprehensive medical insurance in China
bdSpecificNotes: Type A is applied via the Ministry of Education Bangladesh. Type B is applied directly to Chinese designated universities. Many English-taught STEM and medical programs available.

name: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS)
provider: National Institute for International Education (NIIED), South Korea
benefits: 100% Full university tuition fees covered
Round-trip international airfare
Monthly allowance of 1,000,000 KRW (~80,000 BDT/month)
Settlement allowance of 200,000 KRW upon arrival
1 full year of intensive Korean language training before degree
bdSpecificNotes: Embassy Track circular published by the Ministry of Education Bangladesh. University Track applications are submitted directly to partner Korean universities.

name: Swedish Institute (SI) Scholarship for Global Professionals
benefits: Full tuition fee paid directly to the Swedish university
Monthly living expenses stipend of SEK 12,000 (~1.4 Lakh BDT/month)
One-time travel grant of SEK 15,000 for flights from Bangladesh
Health and accident insurance
Membership in the SI Network for Future Global Leaders (NFGL)
bdSpecificNotes: Requires a minimum of 3,000 documented hours of work experience and demonstrated leadership experience. Must first apply to a Swedish Master course via UniversityAdmissions.se in January.

name: Finland Scholarship & University Tuition Waivers
provider: Finnish National Agency for Education (EDUFI) & Finnish Universities
benefits: 100% Tuition fee waiver for the entire 2-year Master degree
€5,000 relocation grant paid directly upon arrival in Finland
Automated consideration upon submitting study application
bdSpecificNotes: No separate scholarship application required. You simply tick the scholarship box during the joint study application on Studyinfo.fi.

name: Italian Regional DSU Scholarships (EDISU / DSU Toscana / LazioDisco)
benefits: Complete exemption from university tuition fees
Free university accommodation or annual housing stipend
Free daily meals at university cafeterias / canteens
Cash stipend of up to €7,500/year paid in two semester instalments
bdSpecificNotes: Need-based rather than merit-based. Bangladeshi families with annual income under 25,000 EUR qualify by submitting an ISEE Parificato document issued via official CAF in Italy.

name: Australia Awards Scholarships
provider: Australian Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT)
benefits: Full tuition fees for Master degree in Australia
Return air travel economy class
Contribution to living expenses (CLE) paid fortnightly
Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC) for the duration of the award
One-off establishment allowance for accommodation and books
bdSpecificNotes: Targeted priority fields: Economic Growth, Education, Governance, Health, Gender Equality, and Climate Change. Applicants must return to Bangladesh for at least 2 years.
